description: Monitoring suszy is a dataset listed in dane.gov.pl, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ministerstwo Rolnictwa i Rozwoju Wsi. Klimatyczny bilans wodny dla poszczególnych gatunków roślin uprawnych i gleb w okresie sześciodekadowym. Coverage: Ministerstwo Rolnictwa i Rozwoju Wsi. The publisher named on the listing is Ministerstwo Rolnictwa i Rozwoju Wsi. Its keywords include susza, rolnictwo. The listing shows 6 download or service links in XLSX. The listing shows 2024-03-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dane-gov-pl.
